title: Projected old-age dependency ratio, 2050 (people 65+ per 100 working-age)

source.name: Old-age dependency ratio indicator / OECD Employment Outlook 2025
source.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

notes: Old-age dependency ratio (people aged 65+ per 100 people aged 15-64/20-64), 2050 projection, as reported in OECD population-ageing analysis (OECD Employment Outlook 2025 and related OECD projections): Japan ~80.7, South Korea ~75.6, Italy ~70.4.
